name: naruhodo-manga-translator
description: Chrome extension that translates Japanese manga pages in place

scripts.test:browser: npm run build:e2e && npm run site:build && playwright test
scripts.e2e: npm run build:e2e && playwright test --config playwright.e2e.config.ts
scripts.record:ocr: npm run build:e2e && playwright test --config playwright.record.config.ts
scripts.smoke: vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts && npm run build:e2e && playwright test --config playwright.smoke.config.ts
scripts.smoke:paddle: npm run build:e2e && playwright test --config playwright.smoke-paddle.config.ts
